definitions.explanation: A person who represents or speaks on behalf of a group, organization, or country.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{代表者|だいひょうしゃ}が{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: The company representative attended the meeting.

examples.japanese: {各|かく}クラスから{代表者|だいひょうしゃ}を{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please select a representative from each class.

examples.japanese: {代表者|だいひょうしゃ}として{挨拶|あいさつ}をした。
examples.english: I gave a greeting as the representative.

notes:
COMPOUND: {代表|だいひょう} (representation) + {者|しゃ} (person)

SIMILAR TERMS:
- {代表|だいひょう} (representation, representative - can be noun or する verb)
- {代理人|だいりにん} (agent, proxy)
- {委員|いいん} (committee member)
- {議員|ぎいん} (assembly member, legislator)

USAGE:
- {代表者|だいひょうしゃ}を{選|えら}ぶ (choose a representative)
- {代表者|だいひょうしゃ}として (as a representative)
- {代表者|だいひょうしゃ}{会議|かいぎ} (representatives' meeting)
